import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] a = new long[17];

    static {
        long m = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 17; i++) {
            a[i] = m;
            m = m * 10 + 1;
        }
    }

    static long fn(long n, int l) {
        long num = n / a[l];
        n %= a[l];
        if (n == 0) {
            return num * l;
        }
        return num * l + Math.min(l + fn(a[l] - n, l - 1), fn(n, l - 1));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        System.out.println(fn(n, 16));
        sc.close();
    }
}
